facts.fact: The UCC ordered operators and ISPs to suspend public internet access, new SIM sales and outbound roaming ahead of the 15 January 2026 polls; the document says the blackout paralysed social media, web browsing and mobile money (Airtel mobile money was hit), and that a National Security Council directive reached the UCC executive director.

note: Parliament's Public Accounts Committee demanding the directives is a committee of the state, not a named paper, party, body or group, so no debate fact.
